title: Release Cap on Authorizations Issued After an Overturned Denial, Referrals and Authorizations
content:
Under **Referrals and Authorizations**, an authorization issued on an overturned denial releases no more than the reconsideration reversed when its cancellation is confirmed.

## Records read

- The authorization's unit history: whether it shows a grant on an appeal overturn.
- The patient's most recent reconsideration of the authorization: the latest case in **Appeals and Grievances**, by filing date, whose subject is the authorization, and its decision.
- The units requested on the authorization.

## Rule

1. Where the unit history shows a grant on an appeal overturn and the patient's most recent reconsideration of the authorization is decided overturned, the units left are capped at the units requested less the units used and less the lines counted as used.
2. Where the unit history shows such a grant and that reconsideration is decided partially overturned, the units left are capped at half the units requested, rounded down, less the same.
3. Otherwise the units left are not capped.

The cap is applied to the units left as they stand after the units used and the lines counted as used are taken off; the lower of the two figures stands.

## Cases (hypothetical; 40 units requested, 10 units used, 2 lines counted as used)

| Grant on an appeal overturn | Decision | Units left before the cap | Cap | Units left |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | decided overturned | 38 | 28 (40 less 10 less 2) | 28 |
| yes | decided partially overturned | 38 | 8 (20 less 10 less 2) | 8 |
| yes | decided overturned | 20 | 28 | 20 |
| no | any | 38 | none | 38 |
